knobs.name: bump_wrong_amount
knobs.mechanism: harness sends BUMP(amount+1) while the plan expects the planned amounts: every Bumped payload, the final Counter and the relayed LastCount move by one; the next test opens with RESET, so nothing ripples

knobs.name: bump_zero

L5-1: event rustCounter.Bumped(value=2) precedes event rustCounter.Saturated(value=3, threshold=3)

knobs.mechanism: both planned BUMP(2) are sent as BUMP(0): the counter stays 0, so Bumped(2), Saturated(3, 3) and the precedes check all fail; L6-1 does not read the counter and L7-1 resets it

knobs.name: limit_not_set
knobs.mechanism: the planned SET_LIMIT(4) is sent as SET_LIMIT(4000): the UUT limit is never exceeded by the count 10; the closing SET_LIMIT(4294967295) restores the limit L6-1 expects

knobs.name: negative_wrong_limit
knobs.mechanism: the negative control sends SET_LIMIT(1) instead of SET_LIMIT(0): the command is accepted (LimitSet, Limit 1), so the rejection never happens; the limit stays 1 into L7-1, where the only count is 0 and does not exceed it, so nothing ripples

knobs.name: skip_reset
knobs.mechanism: the planned RESET is replaced by CdhCore.cmdDisp.CMD_NO_OP: no ResetIssued, no count travels the port chain, and in L7-1 the counter stays at 3 (left by L5-1) so Counter is not 0 and no count 0 reaches LastCount (its last sample stays 10 from L2-5); L2-2 opens with its own RESET, so nothing ripples

knobs.name: threshold_not_saved
knobs.mechanism: the planned FileHandling.prmDb.PRM_SAVE_FILE is replaced by CdhCore.cmdDisp.CMD_NO_OP: the parameter file on the UUT is never written, so PrmFileSaveComplete is absent, the downlinked PrmDb.dat (if any earlier file exists) does not hold THRESHOLD 42, and the auditor's final-state parse fails; this is the fault that disturbs the final-state artifact

knobs.name: threshold_not_set
knobs.mechanism: the planned THRESHOLD_PRM_SET(5) is sent as THRESHOLD_PRM_SET(100): the UUT keeps the default threshold and BUMP(9) does not saturate; the closing THRESHOLD_PRM_SET(100) restores the state L5-1 expects
